item.title: 📅 Today's Timetable (Aug 19, 2026)
item.description: 🌅 Fajr • 04:17 AM ☀️ Sunrise • 05:36 AM 🌤️ Dhuhr • 12:02 PM ⛅ Asr • 03:29 PM 🌆 Maghrib • 06:28 PM 🌙 Isha • 07:47 PM

item.title: 🌅 Fajr — 04:17 AM
item.description:
📖 Quran: "Establish prayer at the two ends of the day and at the approach of the night." [Surah Hud 11:114]
📜 Hadith: Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) said: "Whoever prays the Fajr prayer, he is under the protection of Allah." [Sahih Muslim 657]

item.title: ☀️ Sunrise — 05:36 AM
item.description: 📜 Hadith: Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) said: "Whoever prays Fajr in congregation then sits remembering Allah until the sun rises, then prays two rak'ahs, will have a reward like that of Hajj and 'Umrah." [Jami' at-Tirmidhi 586]

item.title: 🌤️ Dhuhr — 12:02 PM
item.description: 📜 Hadith: Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) said: "This is an hour in which the gates of the heavens are opened, and I like that a righteous deed of mine ascends during it." [Jami' at-Tirmidhi 161]

item.title: ⛅ Asr — 03:29 PM
item.description: 📜 Hadith: Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) said: "Whoever prays the two cool prayers (Fajr and 'Asr) will enter Paradise." [Sahih al-Bukhari 574]

item.title: 🌇 Sunset — 06:28 PM
item.description: 📖 Quran: "And glorify the praises of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting." [Surah Qaf 50:39]

item.title: 🌆 Maghrib — 06:28 PM
item.description: 📜 Hadith: Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) said: "My Ummah will continue to be upon goodness so long as they do not delay Maghrib until the stars intertwine." [Sunan Abi Dawud 418]

item.title: 🌙 Isha — 07:47 PM
item.description: 📜 Hadith: Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) said: "If people knew what reward there is in the Isha and Fajr prayers, they would come to them even if they had to crawl." [Sahih al-Bukhari 615]

item.title: 🌌 Imsak — 04:07 AM
item.description: 📖 Quran: "And eat and drink until the white thread of dawn becomes distinct to you from the black thread." [Surah Al-Baqarah 2:187]

item.title: 🌌 Midnight — 12:02 AM
item.description:
📖 Quran: "Arise [to pray] the night, except for a little..." [Surah Al-Muzzammil 73:2]
📜 Hadith: Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) said: "The most beloved of prayer to Allah is the prayer of David (AS)... he would sleep half the night, stand in prayer for a third, and sleep for a sixth." [Sahih al-Bukhari 1131]

item.title: ✨ Firstthird — 10:10 PM
item.description: 📖 Quran: "And from [part of] the night, pray with it as additional [worship] for you..." [Surah Al-Isra 17:79]

item.title: 🌟 Lastthird — 01:53 AM
item.description:
📖 Quran: "And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness." [Surah Adh-Dhariyat 51:18]
📜 Hadith: Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) said: "Our Lord descends every night to the lowest heaven during the last third of the night and says: Who is calling upon Me that I may answer him?" [Sahih al-Bukhari 1145]
